claims.statement: H8: participant counts differ by 58.2x across the three corpora ({'egocentric-10k': 2153, 'ego4d': 923, 'epic-kitchens-100': 37}) -- 'equal frame counts' does not mean equal precision. Computable from public participant counts alone, per PRE-REGISTRATION.md.

H1 (D042 reframe: live Qwen3-VL judge vs. Build AI's own published figures, P0a, N=10000): hand_ge1_rate observed 0.9545 vs published 0.9642 (diff 0.97pp, within +/-2pp); hand_eq2_rate observed 0.8266 vs published 0.7634 (diff 6.32pp, OUTSIDE +/-2pp); active_manipulation_rate observed 0.9128 vs published 0.9166 (diff 0.38pp, within +/-2pp). Pre-registered criterion is ALL THREE within tolerance; 1/3 is not (hand_eq2_rate). Per PRE-REGISTRATION.md's own rule, H1 as stated does NOT hold: this is a replication failure.
H1b (N=10000 each arm): P0a active-manipulation rate 0.9128 vs P0b 0.9096, diff 0.32pp. Pre-registered threshold is >=1pp disagreement; not met -- H1b is null.

H3 (N=2000 per variant): hand-count spread across 5 prompt variants 0.25pp; manipulation spread across 3 variants 1.25pp. Pre-registered criterion is manipulation spread >=5pp AND exceeding the hand-count spread. The direction holds (1.25pp > 0.25pp); the magnitude does not clear the pre-registered floor (1.25pp < 5pp) -- H3's headline prediction is not supported at this judge/prompt set. Also checked: P3 (gloves) alone moves the hand-count figure by 0.05pp against a pre-registered >=2pp threshold -- not met.

Intra-rater reliability (R100 falsification gate, n=34 real overlapping primary/retest pairs, D058's reduced target -- not the pre-registered n=100): hand_count AC1=0.8757 (kappa=0.8480); manipulation AC1=0.9037 (kappa=0.8489). Both clear the pre-registered 0.70 gate: the rubric is decidable, the audit is not deferred. Real n is small (34, not 100) so this reads as a real positive result at reduced precision, not the full-precision one the pre-registration specified.

H4 (N=93 primary labels vs. the single judge in the panel, qwen3-vl, P0b): AC1(judge, human) hand_count=0.7952, manipulation=0.8990. Pre-registered prediction is hand_count higher (perceptual vs. interpretative, PRE-REGISTRATION.md H3's own framing extended to H4); the real result is the OPPOSITE direction: manipulation agreement is higher.

H5 (primary-labelled subset: n=33 Egocentric, n=30 EPIC-KITCHENS-100): judge error rate on manipulation vs. human gold -- Egocentric 0.0909, EPIC-KITCHENS-100 0.0000, diff -9.09pp. Pre-registered criterion is >=5pp with EPIC-KITCHENS-100 higher; NOT met -- the direction is also REVERSED (Egocentric's error rate is higher). Real sample is far below the pre-registered balanced-gold size (D057), and H5 was already found underpowered even at that full size (docs/DECISIONS.md D035) -- a null or reversed result here is genuinely ambiguous between 'no domain-bias effect at this threshold' and 'this sample cannot reliably surface one,' not a clean refutation.

PPI-corrected prevalence, Egocentric-10K (hand_count, n_gold=33, n_unlabelled=167): naive (judge-only) 0.9550, PPI++ 0.9272 (95% CI [0.8609, 0.9934]), published 0.9642. Not clustered: HumanLabel carries no shared participant/cluster id with FrameRef (docs/DECISIONS.md D039, unfixed) -- this interval is a lower bound on true width, not the full cluster-aware one.

Not clustered: HumanLabel carries no shared participant/cluster id with FrameRef (docs/DECISIONS.md D039, unfixed) -- this interval is a lower bound on true width, not the full cluster-aware one.

H7 (D060: calibration read from qwen3-vl's P0b logprob confidence, a real, disclosed deviation from PRE-REGISTRATION.md's 'P7 only' scoping -- the retired closed judges needed P7 to expose any confidence at all; this self-hosted judge exposes it on every call): hand_count ECE=0.1505 (n=93); manipulation ECE=0.0645 (n=93). Confidence is near-degenerate under greedy decoding (temperature=0, D053): hand_count 99% of frames land in the top [0.9, 1.0] bin; manipulation 99% of frames land in the top [0.9, 1.0] bin -- ECE here is measured almost entirely from that one bin, not a real spread across confidence levels. A real number, not a fabricated one, but a weak calibration curve by construction, not a limitation of the estimator.

sample_definition: E10k-ego/E10k-ego4d/E10k-epic (10,000 each), P2k (2,000), G200-ego/G200-ego4d/G200-epic (200 each), and R100 (100) are drawn and persisted (scripts/draw_all_samples.py, docs/DECISIONS.md D045). E10k-ego (N=10,000, both P0a/P0b) and P2k (N=2,000, 8 prompt-variant-passes) have real, complete live-judge runs behind the H1/H1b/H3 claims (docs/DECISIONS.md D054/D055). All three G200-* sets (200 each) are also fully live-judged (D059, scripts/judge_gold_sets.py); Wave 3's real human gold (93 primary / 34-overlap retest, D057/D058) is matched against them for the intra-rater/H4/H5/PPI claims above. R100 needed no separate judge run -- it is a subset of the G200-* union. S10k-U/S10k-S are not drawn: the raw Egocentric-10K corpus this account has confirmed access to read metadata for but not download (docs/DECISIONS.md D044). H8 needs no sample at all -- public participant counts only.
